stem: Two packages from the same lot develop different storage conditions over time. Which investigation is most defensible?
choices: Compare package barrier properties, seal integrity, fill condition, opening history, storage exposure, and initial moisture uniformity
Assume cultivar variation is the only possible cause because the packages contain the same lot
Ignore seal condition because all closed packages provide identical barriers
Combine both packages so the lot has one average condition
rationale: Packaging material, seal integrity, headspace, handling, storage environment, and starting moisture can all change the internal package environment and should be preserved through traceable records.
